title: 私が姫！プリンセスロードへ爆走です！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Listen here, little boys! I won't let you get away with teasing that girl who shares my dream of becoming a princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It makes me think back to when I was little, trying to join several prestigious running clubs, only to be rejected…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I've pulverized weakness out of my heart! Now that I have Trainer with me, I'll definitely become the strongest princess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Get ready to eat my Princess☆Tackle—ah, but my body feels all out of whack, and I can't run well! What's going on?!
